newsitem.title: UK: George says did not "seriously" consider resigning.
newsitem.headline: George says did not "seriously" consider resigning.

text.p: Bank of England Governor Eddie George said he had not seriously considered resigning over regulatory changes announced by Chancellor of the Exchequer Gordon Brown on Tuesday.
Asked at a news conference if the changes had caused him to consider resigning, he replied: "All sorts of things go through your mind, but frankly not seriously."

He said the fact that Brown had not consulted him about his plans to transfer supervisory responsibility for financial institutions from the Bank to a strengthened Securities and Investment Board should not be exaggerated and the policy shift had been well signalled.
"You shouldn't make too much of the lack of consultation," he said. "The surprise was in the timing."
